At one point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], a '''battle''' took place in the [[Calonica system/Legends|Calonica system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] in which the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was victorious over the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />
